mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_inference_cache (imageHash, modelVersion, weightSha256, preprocessVersion, inferencePolicyVersion, predictedLabel, probability, calibratedProbability, calibrationStatus, description, reliabilityScore, topPredictions, qualityScore, qualityReasons, isOod, oodScore, oodStatus, rejected, abstainReason, requiresReview, createTime) VALUES (#{imageHash}, #{modelVersion}, #{weightSha256}, #{preprocessVersion}, #{inferencePolicyVersion}, #{predictedLabel}, #{probability}, #{calibratedProbability}, #{calibrationStatus}, #{description}, #{reliabilityScore}, #{topPredictions}, #{qualityScore}, #{qualityReasons}, #{isOod}, #{oodScore}, #{oodStatus}, #{rejected}, #{abstainReason}, #{requiresReview}, #{createTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
